sources.older: 2024 Older Adult Compendium of Physical Activities (Willis EA et al., Journal of Sport and Health Science, 2024), MET60 values (https://pacompendium.com/older-adult-compendium/). Used for residents where it has an entry.
sources.adult: 2024 Adult Compendium of Physical Activities (Herrmann SD et al., Journal of Sport and Health Science, 2024) (https://pacompendium.com/adult-compendium/). Used for staff and visitors, and for residents where the Older Adult Compendium has no entry (sleeping, reading, talking, eating, toileting).

note: First matching entry wins: `aid` matches part of the card's mobility aid, `below_mps` the walking speed, `in_bed` whether they're in bed. Receiving care and being hoisted are passive (lying or sitting quietly); a hoist transfer is instant in the engine, so hoisting shows on that tick only.

lying.description: Lying quietly, doing nothing, lying in bed awake

on_floor.description: Lying quietly, doing nothing, lying in bed awake

standing.description: Standing quietly, standing in a line

chatting.description: Sitting: talking in person, on the phone, computer, or text messaging, light effort

toileting.description: Sitting on toilet, eliminating while standing or squatting

walking.description: Walking, less than 1.0 mph, level, strolling, very slow
Walking, 1.0 to 1.9 mph, level, slow pace, firm surface

receiving_care.description: Lying quietly, doing nothing, lying in bed awake

walking.description: Walking, less than 2.0 mph, level, strolling, very slow
Walking, 2.0 to 2.4 mph, level, slow pace, firm surface
Walking, 2.8 to 3.4 mph, level, moderate pace, firm surface

talking.description: Standing: talking in person, on the phone, computer, text messaging, writing

desk_work.description: Sitting tasks, light effort (e.g., office work, reading, desk work)

tidying.description: Custodial work, light effort (e.g., cleaning sink and toilet, dusting, light cleaning)

personal_care.description: Elder care, disabled adult, bathing, dressing, moving into and out of bed, only active periods

hoisting.description: Elder care, disabled adult, bathing, dressing, moving into and out of bed, only active periods

assisting_meal.description: Elder care, disabled adult, feeding, combing hair, light effort, only active periods

serving.description: Serving food, setting/cleaning table, implied walking or standing

handover.description: Sitting meetings, light effort, general, and/or with talking involved

visiting.description: Sitting: talking in person, on the phone, computer, or text messaging, light effort
